name: Relationship Reading
purpose: How two people fit — the ease, the friction, and what the connection is asking of each of you.
method: Synastry and composite chart analysis for any significant pair: partners, family members, friends, business partners.
bestFor: Couples wanting to understand their dynamic more honestly
A new or prospective partnership — romantic or business
A long-standing relationship whose patterns you'd like to see clearly
notFor: A verdict on whether to stay or go — the charts describe dynamics; the choice remains yours
Reading someone's chart without their knowledge — bring questions, not surveillance
intakeRequirements: Birth date, exact time, and place for both people
The relationship context and your questions
includes: Synastry: how each chart activates the other
The composite chart: the relationship as its own entity
Strengths to lean on, frictions to name, and themes the connection keeps raising
preparation: Gather accurate birth data for both people — ideally from birth certificates
Both people attending is welcome but not required
cancellationPolicy: See the booking policy — to be confirmed by owner.
reschedulingPolicy: See the booking policy — to be confirmed by owner.
